Project Topic






TipOur Goal



This project evaluates the sufficiency of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure across cities in Türkiye. By analyzing both supply and demand, we aim to identify regions where charging demand exceeds available capacity and provide data-driven investment recommendations for new stations.
Key Data Components: * Demand: Number of registered EVs by city (TÜİK) and average energy consumption per session. * Supply: Charging station locations, socket counts, and power capacities (EPDK).

title: Analysis
text:
Electric Vehicle Density by City
This density map visualizes the current distribution of electric vehicles. Cities are color-coded based on their total vehicle count, with darker shades indicating higher numbers. You can hover over any city to view its exact number of electric vehicles.


Show the code
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(stringi)

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/crndo/OneDrive/Belgeler/emu430-fall2024-team-ac-dc/NumofEV.csv", 
                     header = TRUE, 
                     sep = ";",
                     encoding = "UTF-8")

tr_map <- ne_states(country = "Turkey", returnclass = "sf")

plot(st_geometry(tr_map))









Show the code
df$City <- stri_trans_general(df$City, "latin-ascii")

tr_map$name <- stri_trans_general(tr_map$name, "latin-ascii")


df <- df %>%
  mutate(City = case_when(
    City == "Zonguldak" ~ "Zinguldak",
    City == "Kahramanmaras" ~ "K. Maras",
    City == "Kirikkale" ~ "Kinkkale",
    TRUE ~ City
  )) 

harita_veri <- left_join(tr_map, df, by = c("name" = "City"))

harita_veri <- harita_veri %>%
  mutate(EVcount_log = log10(EVcount + 1))

pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = harita_veri$EVcount_log, na.color = "transparent")

leaflet(harita_veri) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% 
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(EVcount_log),             
    weight = 1,                                  
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",                             
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(         
      weight = 3,
      color = "#666",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = ~paste0(name, ": ", EVcount), 
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto")
  ) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal, 
            values = ~EVcount_log,             
            opacity = 0.7, 
            title = "Number of Electric Vehicles",
            position = "bottomright",
            labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) round(10^x - 1),
                                    big.mark = ",")
            )
